after.zh: 每个通道除以白纸在这个通道的读数，灯的颜色就抵消了。相机的「白平衡」做的就是这件事：找一个应该是白色的东西，按它把三个通道拉齐。照片里最亮的东西当白色，叫「白块假设」；照片里没有白东西时，它就会出错。
after.en: Divide each channel by the white paper's reading in that channel, and the colour of the lamp cancels out. A camera's "white balance" does exactly this: find something that ought to be white and even up the three channels by it. Taking the brightest thing as white is called the "white patch" assumption; it fails when nothing in the photo is white.

t.zh: 这是一道挑战关，可以跳过。它不需要新元件。
t.en: This is a challenge level, and you can skip it. It needs no new parts.

t.zh: 在偏黄的灯下拍照，白纸会发黄，整张照片都带着灯的颜色。人眼会自动纠正，相机得靠「白平衡」。
t.en: Photographed under a yellowish lamp, white paper looks yellow and the whole picture takes on the lamp's colour. Your eyes correct for it automatically; a camera needs "white balance".

caption.zh: 第一组测试：黄灯下的书桌
caption.en: Set 1: a desk under a yellow lamp

t.zh: 这一关你要做的：每张照片里都有一块白纸，它在 R、G、B 里都是最亮的。让白纸变回纯白，其余颜色跟着还原。
t.en: Your task in this level: every photo has a patch of white paper, the brightest thing in each of R, G and B. Make the paper pure white again and let every other colour be restored with it.

brief.zh: 这些照片是在偏黄的灯下拍的，白纸看上去发黄。每张照片里都有一块白纸，而且它在 R、G、B 里都是最亮的。把三个通道各自调整，让白纸变成纯白 (1, 1, 1)，其余颜色跟着一起还原。
brief.en: These photos were taken under a yellowish lamp, so white paper looks yellow. Every photo has a patch of white paper in it, the brightest thing in each of R, G and B. Adjust each channel so the paper becomes pure white (1, 1, 1), and every other colour is restored along with it.

hint.zh: 白纸本来应该是什么颜色？
hint.en: What colour should the white paper really be?
